proposedContracts.name: matches native erosion for every format, coordinate mask, per-plane threshold and size on the linear and graph planners
proposedContracts.scope: 3024 linear/graph raw comparisons over 6 formats, 12 coordinate masks, 6 per-plane threshold sets and 4 sizes with noise and block frames.

proposedContracts.name: matches native rawvideo and framecrc bytes through the -vf, -filter_complex and timed backend CLIs
proposedContracts.scope: 576 rawvideo and framecrc CLI outputs on linear, graph, stream, actor (activation, producer) and timed (pull).

proposedContracts.name: matches native replayed erosion branches frame by frame
proposedContracts.scope: 24 replay graphs with split/hstack/transpose/nullsink branches; raw bytes and PTS.

proposedContracts.name: refuses one pixel wide erosion planes on every path before opening outputs
proposedContracts.scope: Explicit refusal on all five paths with no output opened for one pixel wide luma or chroma planes; no native comparison (native reads out of bounds).

proposedContracts.name: parses native defaults, shorthand order, ranges and integer expressions into frozen steps
proposedContracts.scope: Parser defaults, shorthand, AV_OPT_TYPE_INT ranges/expressions, refusals and descriptor facts.

proposedContracts.name: erodes with mirrored borders, clamped rows, coordinate masks and thresholds into owned tight planes
proposedContracts.scope: Hand-computed kernel results; owned tight output, copied PTS/metadata, unmutated input.

proposedContracts.name: refuses one pixel wide planes, unsupported layouts, budgets, malformed storage, settings and cancellation explicitly
proposedContracts.scope: Width-1 geometry, formats, maxFrameBytes, strides, plane counts, time base, invalid steps, AbortSignal.

proposedContracts.name: budgets linear and graph plans, negotiates native formats and refuses timeline and runtime commands
proposedContracts.scope: Linear plan budgets, nv12 negotiation to yuv420p, width-1 graph refusal, enable= and runtime command refusal.

notes: Setup durations: submodule 34s, npm ci 7s, reference:build 134s, baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+unit 111s total (unit about 100s).
The registry.ts edit landed while the baseline unit run was in progress; the baseline failures are the 13 known FLAC/resample ones and are unrelated.
Differential test file runs in about 8s with --maxWorkers=1.
Mutation check: changing the left border mirror or dropping the threshold floor fails three differential tests.
No other shared edits were needed. The kernel imports filterIntegerOption from activation/integer-option.ts (existing, not modified).
